zh: 她是一名工程师。
en: She is {an::article} engineer.

zh: 这部手机比那部便宜。
en: This phone is {cheaper::cheap} than that one.

zh: 法律规定，坐车必须系安全带。
en: It's the law. You {must|have to::modal} wear a seatbelt in the car.

zh: 我喜欢给朋友们做饭。
en: I enjoy {cooking::cook} for my friends.

zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就取消烧烤。
en: If it {rains::rain} tomorrow, we {will cancel::cancel} the barbecue.

zh: 今天天气真好，是吧？
en: It's a lovely day, {isn't::tag} it?

zh: 我们一点牛奶都没有了。
en: We don't have {any::some/any} milk left.

zh: 发工资之前我只剩一点点钱了。
en: I only have {a little::a few/a little} money left until payday.

zh: 这咖啡太烫了，没法喝。
en: This coffee is {too::too/enough} hot to drink.

zh: 她说她很累。
en: She said she {was::be} tired.

zh: 我每天早上喝一杯咖啡。
en: I have {a::article} coffee every morning.

zh: 你的英语比我的好。
en: Your English is {better::good} than mine.

zh: 你要是忙，就不必来了。
en: You {don't have to|do not have to|don't need to|do not need to|needn't::modal} come if you're busy.

zh: 昨晚我们决定待在家里。
en: Last night we decided {to stay::stay} at home.

zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
en: I'll call you as soon as I {get::get} home.

zh: 你不吃肉，对吧？
en: You don't eat meat, {do::tag} you?

zh: 你想喝点茶吗？
en: Would you like {some::some/any} tea?

zh: 我请了几个朋友来家里吃晚饭。
en: I invited {a few::a few/a little} friends over for dinner.

zh: 他年龄还不够大，不能开车。
en: He isn't old {enough::too/enough} to drive.

zh: 他告诉我他会给我回电话。
en: He told me he {would call::will call} me back.

zh: 会议开了一个小时。
en: The meeting lasted {an::article} hour.

zh: 今天的交通比昨天更糟。
en: The traffic is {worse::bad} than yesterday.

zh: 你咳成这样，应该去看医生。
en: You {should|ought to::modal} see a doctor about that cough.

zh: 我很期待下周和你见面。
en: I'm looking forward to {meeting::meet} you next week.

zh: 你要是不快点，就会错过公交车。
en: If you {don't hurry|do not hurry::not hurry}, you {will miss::miss} the bus.

zh: 她会开车，不是吗？
en: She can drive, {can't::tag} she?

zh: 大家有什么问题吗？
en: Are there {any::some/any} questions?

zh: 公司附近没有多少停车位。
en: There aren't {many::much/many} parking spaces near the office.

zh: 我们的椅子不够所有人坐。
en: We don't have {enough::too/enough} chairs for everyone.

zh: 她问我住在哪里。
en: She asked me where I {lived::live}.

zh: 他在惠灵顿的一所大学工作。
en: He works at {a::article} university in Wellington.

zh: 这台笔记本电脑比旧的那台贵。
en: This laptop is {more expensive::expensive} than the old one.

zh: 带件外套吧，待会儿可能会下雨。
en: Take a jacket. It {might|may|could::modal} rain later.

zh: 你介意开一下窗户吗？
en: Would you mind {opening::open} the window?

zh: 除非我们现在就走，否则会迟到。
en: Unless we {leave::leave} now, we'll be late.

zh: 他们去年去了斐济，对吧？
en: They went to Fiji last year, {didn't::tag} they?

zh: 这个表格我需要一些帮助。
en: I need {some::some/any} help with this spreadsheet.

zh: 他问我能不能帮他搬家。
en: He asked me if I {could::can} help him move house.

zh: 新西兰的太阳非常晒。
en: {The::article} sun is really strong in New Zealand.

zh: 奥克兰是新西兰最大的城市。
en: Auckland is the {biggest::big} city in New Zealand.

zh: 那不可能是汤姆，他这周在澳大利亚。
en: That {can't|cannot::modal} be Tom. He's in Australia this week.

zh: 他尽量避免在高峰时段开车。
en: He avoids {driving::drive} in rush hour.

zh: 如果她通过考试，她就能拿到驾照。
en: If she {passes::pass} the test, she will get her licence.

zh: 你见过我妻子了，对吧？
en: You've met my wife, {haven't::tag} you?

zh: 那是我吃过的最好吃的派。
en: That was {the::article} best pie I've ever had.

zh: 这是我今年读过的最有趣的书。
en: This is the {most interesting::interesting} book I've read this year.

zh: 他开了一整天的车，一定累坏了。
en: He's been driving all day. He {must::modal} be exhausted.

zh: 她提议午饭后去散散步。
en: She suggested {going::go} for a walk after lunch.

zh: 我买了一台笔记本电脑和一个鼠标，但那个鼠标是坏的。
en: I bought a laptop and a mouse, but {the::article} mouse doesn't work.

zh: 那是我吃过的最糟糕的一顿饭。
en: It was the {worst::bad} meal I've ever had.

zh: 我五岁的时候就会游泳了。
en: I {could::modal} swim when I was five.

zh: 我希望很快能再见到你。
en: I hope {to see::see} you again soon.

zh: 请把门关上，好吗？
en: Could you close {the::article} door, please?

zh: 你能说得慢一点吗？
en: Could you speak a bit {more slowly|slower::slowly}, please?

zh: 昨天我不得不加班到很晚。
en: I {had to::modal} work late yesterday.

zh: 我们打算七月去皇后镇玩。
en: We're planning {to visit::visit} Queenstown in July.

zh: 我的新公寓比原来那个离公司更远。
en: My new flat is {further|farther::far} from work than the old one.

zh: 他们同意承担一半的费用。
en: They agreed {to pay::pay} half of the cost.

zh: 我们走得越早，路上的车就越少。
en: The {earlier::early} we leave, the {less::little} traffic there will be.

zh: 我已经戒掉了午饭后喝咖啡的习惯。
en: I've stopped {drinking::drink} coffee after lunch.
